finding.claim: With the default empty embed.allowed_domains, no domain filter is installed, so any https URL in Markdown is fetched server-side and the remote HTML is emitted unescaped, bypassing html_input=escape/strip.
finding.source: Markdown input: a paragraph-free line consisting only of an https:// URL (EmbedStartParser.php:34-49). Precondition: the embed extension is registered and allowed_domains is left at its default [].
finding.sink: OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43-47 calls getMulti() on the attacker URL and calls setEmbedCode() with the remote code->html; EmbedRenderer.php:33 returns getEmbedCode() raw.

trace.note: Accepts any line starting with https:// as an embed destination.
Only wraps the adapter in DomainFilteringAdapter when the list is non-empty, so the default is fail-open.
Passes all top-level embeds to the adapter.
Fetches each attacker-chosen URL via the embed library (outbound request from the server).
Stores the remote-supplied HTML as the embed code.
Returns the stored HTML verbatim; html_input filtering is not applied to embeds.

finding.guards_checked: https-only prefix in EmbedStartParser; DomainFilteringAdapter host check (only when allowed_domains is set); EmbedProcessor fallback (only for embeds with no code); html_input does not apply to EmbedRenderer. Not verified: whether the embed library returns attacker-controlled HTML for an attacker-hosted page (its source is not in this repo); whether this default is intended by the maintainers (no docs in repo). Severity medium if the library yields attacker-controlled code.

finding.claim: The domain allowlist checks only the submitted URL's host, not the host reached after redirects, so an allowed domain that redirects (open redirect or attacker-controllable subdomain) can make the server fetch internal or non-allowed hosts.
finding.source: Markdown author supplies an https URL whose host matches allowed_domains, e.g. an open redirect on an allowed host or a user-hosted subdomain under an allowed suffix.
finding.sink: OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43 performs the fetch; the fetcher follows redirects (assumed from the library's default behavior, not verified here).

trace.note: Filters on Embed::getUrl() before the adapter runs.
Suffix match: any subdomain of an allowed domain passes, so attacker-controlled subdomains pass too.
Fetches the URL; the redirect target is never checked against the allowlist or private address ranges.

finding.guards_checked: https-only prefix; parse_url host extraction; exact or dot-suffix host match; UrlEncoder normalizes backslash and other delimiters before the check, so the userinfo-based validator/fetcher mismatch does not apply. Not verified: redirect-following and private-IP handling in the embed library. Confidence low-to-medium; needs the library source or a live test.
